facts.fact: 次日上班被世界除名：Marc 目光滑过、六人零注册、一位女士像避湿滑地板牌般侧身——肩膀都没碰。
facts.anchor: One woman actually stepped sideways to avoid me

facts.fact: Ash 以实体出现在办公隔间角落（文件柜+励志猫海报）；斗嘴调情——「Buy a girl dinner」；她意识到自己在调情。
facts.anchor: a motivational cat poster the previous employee left behind

facts.fact: 走廊同事聚过来——不是朝她，是朝他：渴望低语（婚姻冷淡/夭折的 June/亡妻两只杯子）；「Their longing begs to be eased and followed the scent of relief straight to me.」
facts.anchor: Longing. All of it is their longing.

facts.fact: 他换到窗边自测：人群跟着他挪——「实体出现本身在拉扯凡人理智与欲望的接缝」；无法变回烟雾（body remains stubbornly whole）；「我的关心本身就在扭曲世界」。
facts.anchor: My physical presence upsets the balance

facts.fact: 他决定不告诉她（她背的够多）——谎称测试「只有你能看见我」；真相包着谎，他最爱这种。
facts.anchor: A truth wrapped in a lie. My favorite kind.

facts.fact: 她收花时说「I like it better when it's just us anyway」——他内心地震：第一世她天天说 just us；800 年没出过她的口；她拽他进供应室。
facts.anchor: Those words have not crossed her lips in eight hundred years.

facts.fact: 供应室：他缓慢靠近给她每秒拒绝的机会（她不想推）；嗅颈侧「under it, you smell like mine」；他的手悬腰侧不碰——「这种克制比直接拿走更糟」。
facts.anchor: His hands haven’t moved from where they hover at my waist

facts.fact: 他在最后一寸撤回——她读出「这比对我代价更大」；漏花之歉（「I have never once failed…will not fail again」）；她问为何总送花——他不答。
facts.anchor: “Not here,” he says, rough. “Not like this.”
